passive.name: Nimble Fighter
passive.description: Fizz can move through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources

spells.name: Urchin Strike
spells.description: Fizz dashes through an enemy, dealing physical damage plus magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Seastone Trident
spells.description: Passive: Fizz's Attacks cause his enemies to bleed, dealing magic damage over seconds. Active: Fizz's next Attack deals an additional magic damage. If this Attack kills its target, Fizz refunds Mana and reduces the cooldown of this Ability to second. If it does not kill, Fizz's Attacks deal an additional magic damage for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DoTDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Playful / Trickster
spells.description: Fizz hops onto his trident, becoming Untargetable for 0.75 seconds, after which he deals magic damage to nearby enemies and Slows them by % for seconds. Fizz can Recast this Ability while Untargetable to dash again, which ends the effect early, deals damage in a smaller area, and doesn't Slow.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation EDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Chum the Waters
spells.description: Fizz launches a fish that attaches to the first champion hit. The victim is afflicted with True Sight and Slowed by between 40% to 80% based on how far the fish travelled before attaching. After seconds a shark erupts on the target, Knocking Up the target with the fish for 1 second, Knocking Back everything else, and dealing between to magic damage based on how far the fish travelled before attaching.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation SmallSharkDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
